id: \rWhat was I looking for?
en: \rWhat was I looking for?
it: \rCosa stavo cercando?

id: The ball holds a Chespin. Would you like to take it?
en: The ball holds a Chespin. Would you like to take it?
it: La Ball contiene Chespin. Vuoi prenderlo?

id: The ball holds a Fennekin. Would you like to take it?
en: The ball holds a Fennekin. Would you like to take it?
it: La Poké Ball contiene un Fennekin. Vuoi prenderlo?

id: \bSycamore: Sorry, but I need to find Froakie. We can talk soon.
en: \bSycamore: Sorry, but I need to find Froakie. We can talk soon.
it: \bPlatan: Scusami, ma devo trovare Froakie. Parliamo più tardi.

id: \bSycamore: I see you found Froakie. Thanks for the help. Please take a starter if you want to.
en: \bSycamore: I see you found Froakie. Thanks for the help. Please take a starter if you want to.
it: \bPlatan: Vedo che hai trovato Froakie. Grazie dell'aiuto. Prendi pure uno starter, se ti va.

id: \bYou have a lot of promise. I'm entrusting you with this Mega Ring. I hope you find the answer to what it does.
en: \bYou have a lot of promise. I'm entrusting you with this Mega Ring. I hope you find the answer to what it does.
it: \bHai un grande potenziale. Ti affido questo Megacerchio. Spero che scoprirai a cosa serve.

id: \bSycamore: I study Mega Evolution. I'm hoping Garchomp and I can achieve it soon.
en: \bSycamore: I study Mega Evolution. I'm hoping Garchomp and I can achieve it soon.
it: \bPlatan: Studio la Megaevoluzione. Spero che io e Garchomp riusciremo a raggiungerla presto.

id: \bSycamore: Garchomp and I have figured out Mega Evolution. Take this and see it for yourself.
en: \bSycamore: Garchomp and I have figured out Mega Evolution. Take this and see it for yourself.
it: \bPlatan: Io e Garchomp abbiamo scoperto il segreto della Megaevoluzione. Prendi questo e vedrai tu stesso.

id: \bSycamore: I study Mega Evolution. Garchomp and I are able to do it together.
en: \bSycamore: I study Mega Evolution. Garchomp and I are able to do it together.
it: \bPlatan: Studio la Megaevoluzione. Io e Garchomp riusciamo a usarla insieme.

id: \bAlain: Good to see you again, \PN. I'm on a break from searching for Mega Stones, but a battle would be a good way to keep me sharp.
en: \bAlain: Good to see you again, \PN. I'm on a break from searching for Mega Stones, but a battle would be a good way to keep me sharp.
it: \bAlan: Che piacere rivederti, \PN. Mi sto prendendo una pausa dalla ricerca delle Megapietre, ma una lotta sarebbe un ottimo modo per tenermi in forma.

id: \bAlain: Come back anytime. It's always a rush to battle you.
en: \bAlain: Come back anytime. It's always a rush to battle you.
it: \bAlan: Torna quando vuoi. Lottare contro di te è sempre una scarica di adrenalina.

id: \bSycamore: Welcome to my lab. You're \PN, I believe.
en: \bSycamore: Welcome to my lab. You're \PN, I believe.
it: \bPlatan: Benvenuto nel mio laboratorio. Tu devi essere \PN, se non sbaglio.

id: \bWelcome to Kalos, though I'm sorry to say I'm a bit distracted. A Froakie we take care of left its new Trainer again and we still can't find it.
en: \bWelcome to Kalos, though I'm sorry to say I'm a bit distracted. A Froakie we take care of left its new Trainer again and we still can't find it.
it: \bBenvenuto a Kalos, anche se purtroppo sono un po' distratto. Un Froakie di cui ci prendiamo cura ha abbandonato di nuovo il suo nuovo Allenatore e non riusciamo a trovarlo.

id: \bIf you help us find it I'll let you take a Kalos starter of your own.
en: \bIf you help us find it I'll let you take a Kalos starter of your own.
it: \bSe ci aiuti a trovarlo, ti lascerò prendere uno starter di Kalos tutto per te.

id: Your Pokémon were fully healed.
en: Your Pokémon were fully healed.
it: I tuoi Pokémon sono stati curati completamente.
